evidenceIntegrity.sourceBoundary: Only official CLI public request/attribution requests and exported public visible trace were used; session JSON, source, browser, server, old traces and verification files were not inspected.

verdict: The sealed open-novice player completed and won the full flow without external knowledge. Core resource loops, event-to-raid chains, real combat, disabled-action reasons and final battle were all observable and learnable. Remaining issues are presentation/load and balance clarity rather than a blocked flow.
